title: Two months since it was "a few weeks away," The Athletic hasn't finished its Dianna Russini investigation

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Two months since it was "a few weeks away," The Athletic hasn't finished its Dianna Russini investigation
sources.description: Four months to the day since the controversy first emerged, The Athletic has not yet finalized its internal investigation of its former NFL Insider, Dianna Russini.
